instruction_summary: Study A (001 methods-and-transport): re-analyse Hansen (2015)'s two RD thresholds on the same 1999-2007 WA public file with 2026 RD inference (rdrobust RBC + RDHonest), and check the design's no-sorting assumption on Florida 2021-2026 STED breath tests; the recidivism headline is NOT re-estimated on new data.

steps.description: Verified data hash + staging sha256s (21/21), confirmed Branch N (icpsr do-files absent)
Panel A: A1 RBC, A2 honest, A3 bandwidth curve, A4 coding/donut sensitivity, A5 eras, A6 density, A7 balance
Panel A figures (bandwidth curve, eras, WA density)
Florida ingest: 535 STED PDFs -> 165,162 de-identified tests, privacy-first, per-batch name assertion (0 FL-derived hits), raw PDFs in /tmp only and deleted per batch
Two-extractor structural audit (-layout vs -raw, 30 pages/yr): BrAC/gender/flag agreement 100% all years
Panel B1: rddensity + discrete tests + log-density jump/MDD power (FL vs WA, pooled + by year)
Panel B1 heaping (cutoff share, last-digit chi-square, donut re-run) + B2 gender balance
Panel B3/B4 figures + comparison table + per-year counts
Gate 5: outputs name-free, parquet schema clean (no name/serial/agency/day/time), /tmp/sted + seed deleted

key_results.verdict_all_three: bandwidth-dependent under 2026 inference; point estimate stable (within +/-25% of A0)
key_results.FL_MDD_vs_WA: 0.196 vs 0.100 (0.08); 0.123 vs 0.083 (0.15); FL MDD not > 2x WA -> adequately powered
key_results.FL_heaping: no excess at exact cutoff bins (ratio 1.03); last-digit 0 ~21% (round-value heaping); no-sorting robust to donut (p 0.65/0.39, 0.32/0.22)
key_results.transport_verdict: identifying assumption transports to FL 2021-2026; a FL recidivism RD is feasible on identification grounds (pending person-ID gate), caveat round-value heaping at thresholds

comparison_to_original.followup: A1 RBC -0.0173 [CI excl 0]; A2 honest -0.0150 [CI incl 0]
statutory: RBC & honest incl 0; strict: RBC excl 0, honest incl 0

comparison_to_original.note: modern test agrees with paper, not repl's McCrary

deviations: Part II (002 theory-update) not executed, per the binding launch-scope line (Study A only).
Branch N: openICPSR 112907 do-files not staged -> 0.15 reported under both codings with equal standing (pre-registered).
Recidivism headline not re-estimated on new data (by design; no public person-linked data exists beyond the 1999-2007 WA extract).

Two-extractor audit compares layout-independent quantities (BrAC multiset, presence-based gender/flags): pdftotext -raw reflows the columnar STED form and cannot preserve field-value adjacency for header fields; BrAC character fidelity is 100%.
